title: York, England: a medieval town – B1 English Listening Test

seo.title: York, England: a medieval town – B1 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Get English listening practice with this B1 intermediate comprehension test about travel and history. Feedback & transcription are included!

parts:
B1 English Listening Test

Watch a video about the city of York in England. For questions 1 to 7, say if the statements are true or false.
For more videos like this, go to Loescher Editore video
Questions

questions.prompt: The Romans are the origin of the city of York.
Most of the castle built in 1070 is still there.
No other towns preserve their medieval walls like York.
York was a rich town thanks to its river.
The cathedral, called the Minster, was built in 627.
The Minster has the biggest windows in the world.
The King's Screen features 15 sculptures of William the Conqueror and Henry VI.
